name: @islee23520/lfp
description: LazyCodex flavour pack with art team agents.
author: islee23520

interface.shortDescription: LFP hooks, agents, and model overrides layered on LazyCodex.
interface.longDescription: Adds LFP Codex hooks, agent role files, and vanilla LazyCodex/OMO model override sync without editing upstream plugin cache files. Includes art team agent group for Computer Use-driven creative tool production.
defaultPrompt: Run UI work with visual QA.
Use visual-looker for Gemini multimodal visual evidence inspection.
Use artistry for art direction, artistry-gen for Computer Use production, artistry-qa for visual inspection.
Use sisyphus for Sisyphus-style implementation loops and independent done-claim verification.

tools.name: model_fallback_resolver
tools.description: Given an agent name and optional error reason (quota, rate-limit, 429, error), returns the effective model to use right now (primary or the per-agent fallback defined in LFP ledger). Never writes anything. Safe to call from any agent on quota/rate/provider failure.

agent.description: Agent name, e.g. explorer, metis, plan, sisyphus, visual-engineering, visual-looker, momus

reason.description: Optional error category that triggers fallback: quota, rate-limit, 429, error, fail
